text:
sam: Main CI is red after yesterday's deps refresh — linux-integ shards failing with a symbol lookup error coming from numpy C-extension. @marta any quick ideas?

ci-bot: job failed: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/8765 (linux-integ-1) — exit code 1

marta: hmm, that smells like an ABI/wheel mismatch (manylinux vs runner). Which numpy version did the lock bump pull in?

sam: poetry.lock shows numpy 2.3.1. Previously we were on 1.25.2. I merged the lock regen PR last night. Here's the error tail:```
ImportError: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.9.16/x64/lib/python3.9/site-packages/numpy/core/_multiarray_umath.cpython-39-x86_64-linux-gnu.so: undefined symbol: PyArray_Check
```

alex: yep — numpy 2.x renamed/changed some C symbols and some wheels are built against the new ABI. Our older runners (and some manylinux2014 wheels) can break. We should bisect the lock change to confirm it's the numpy bump.

jen: I can try a quick repro: spinning a job with pip installing numpy==1.25.2 vs 2.3.1. Quick command:```docker run --rm python:3.9 bash -c "pip install numpy==1.25.2 && python -c \"import numpy; print(numpy.__version__, numpy.__file__)\""```

ryan: also check transitive deps (scipy / scikit-learn) — they might have wheels compiled against different numpy ABI. `grep -A2 "numpy" poetry.lock` should show who pulled it in.

sam: running grep now, looks like scipy 1.11.3 is pinned too — likely compatible with 1.25.x but not 2.x. I'm opening a quick revert/pin PR to unblock CI. https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1298 (pin numpy==1.25.2) :pray:

marta: thanks — while that's in flight can someone run `python -c "import numpy; print(numpy.__config__.show())"` from the failing job container to see which BLAS/ABI it's tied to?

ci-bot: rerun triggered by PR 1298 — linux-integ-1 now green, linux-integ-2 still failing on a different shard (macos wheels) — see https://ci.redwood.example/builds/8769

alex: macOS failures often mean the wheel was built for a different macOS/CPython tag (e.g., macosx_13_x86_64 vs our runner's macosx_11). We have to ensure our mac runners are updated or wheels are rebuilt for older macOS tags.

jen: plan: revert the lock regen on main and merge the temporary pin (PR 1298) to get CI green. Then open follow-up to coordinate proper numpy 2.x rollout: update runner images, verify manylinux tags, and test downstream packages. Sound good?

marta: +1 :thumbsup:

ryan: yup — agree. I'll create an issue with the bisect steps and a matrix of runner images vs wheel tags.

sam: thanks all — PR merged, CI is trending green after pins. Creating the follow-up issue now and will drop the bisect notes.

jen: awesome. I'll add a note to the release checklist to run a quick binary-compat smoke test if we try another numpy bump.

marta: adding a short playbook item for future deps bumps: (1) check binary packages for ABI changes, (2) run small CPU/memory matrix, (3) coordinate rebuilds for macOS tags.

sam: perfect — closing the loop here, will link the follow-up issue in the revert PR. :white_check_mark:
